text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Jingle bells~♪ Jingle bells~♪
Jingle all the way~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Air Groove?
Come to think of it, where is Ruler-chan?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: She said she wouldn't be able to make it to the school Christmas party this year. Apparently...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"There's an internal Christmas party with my friends.
So I won't participate. I won't go outside," he said.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a shame!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I suppose she has found her own circle of friends.
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is a good thing to expand one's circle of friends.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's play a variety of board games
with a big group today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Which one do you want to do, Kiseki?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I really like manga, so if there's an adaptation or something based on one...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this box...! It's art from a manga I know!
I had no idea they turned this into a board game too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, back in the day, they used to make board games out of manga and anime
where you'd think, 'How could you possibly turn this into a board game?!'"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This room is fully stocked with
all sorts of retro collections, after all.

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Is that so!
Umm... which one should I pick...

text_block_list.name: Thunder God Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Hm, this space fleet game says you can use a weapon called the "Thunder God Cannon."
Maybe I'll go with this one.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All ships, charge!
Latch onto the enemy fleet's tail!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... I wonder if we can do it?
If we adopt the same strategy—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The ouroboros—a loop of mutual pursuit—is complete.
You will never be able to win.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, there was a move like that...?! As expected of Ruler-senpai...
choice_data_list: Ahaha, they were one step ahead of us.
Ahaha, they outsmarted us, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well then, thank you for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, see you then.
On the day of the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I shall display a brilliant strategy in races as well.
Not just in fleet battles, mind you."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm really looking forward to it!

And so, after seeing the three of them off,
I spent some relaxing time alone with Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer. By the way,
I have a small question for you—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I wonder why we burst out of the gates in the first place.
choice_data_list: ...Talking about races?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: No, in this context, it refers to a much broader sort of 'gate.'

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: In this day and age, you can live a perfectly fun life without ever having to go outside.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You can enjoy playing video games or watching shows alone, or gather your friends together for board games.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "If you ask for food, they'll bring it right to you, won't they? There's no particular need to go out."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: School and work are unavoidable, but there's no reason to go out when you don't need to and get wrapped up in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Am I wrong?
choice_data_list: Well, when you put it like that...

text_block_list.text: I can certainly do more indoors now. It doesn't cause any real issues in my daily life.

However, it isn't very realistic.
Especially for Umamusume...
choice_data_list: Doesn't it stress you out if you don't run?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I've got nothing at all.
Though maybe that's just me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well... it might just be that we Umamusume
haven't optimized for indoor life yet.
choice_data_list: Optimization...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the change in environment was just so sudden
that my body hasn't quite caught up yet, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We are a race that "runs."
Once, running and living were synonymous.
However...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The necessity and urgency to run right now
is gradually fading away.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just because a new card pack came out
doesn't mean one can simply go, 'Alright, swap!'

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"So, an era where Umamusume no longer run
might eventually come. If that happens..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Then there won't be anything left for the Trainer to do either.
choice_data_list: Yeah...
That's true...

text_block_list.text: Rulership and I might no longer be working together.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: If such a day ever comes...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, pure bliss...
That's heaven in its own way, for sure~~~.
choice_data_list: Huh... Heaven?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Just think about it! From morning 'til night,
we can hang out and play together the whole time, ya know???"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: We could do it in either of our rooms, or we could just play online, right?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "That is—the world I desire. I almost feel that if I became ruler, that is precisely the world I ought to create."
choice_data_list: I-I see...

text_block_list.text:
The idea of parting ways doesn't seem to cross Rulership's mind at all.
However...

They didn't start out meeting as an Umamusume and her Trainer.
That, too, felt only natural.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, thinking through all of this...
It turns out my true nemesis isn't
Pisa, nor is it Buena—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Looks like the starting gates.
choice_data_list: Are you going to... take down the gate?
You're going to... take down the gate?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll make a world where you don't have to go outside
when you don't feel like it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I am certain many people
will agree with this."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or... Rulership's
info, that is...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I hear she's declaring, 'I will not leave the gates.
Eventually, I will tear those gates down!'"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I thought you were a strategist, but it turns out you are a fanatic.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Not knowing what she might pull next makes things troublesome.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you don't need to worry.
I have a few tricks up my sleeve too.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"If they won't leave the gate and plan to launch a surprise attack from the very back...
Then let's go with this."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Fight poison with poison."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I see...
So I must "summon" it—is that it?
And the Christmas night grew deeper.
choice_data_list: Well, I should probably head out soon...
Well then, I should get going...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh, are you heading home already~~~?
Eeeh, that's so boringgg."

Even so, I can't just not go home.
Instead...
choice_data_list: Let's hop online when we're back!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Oh, good point. Let's go with that one then.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas, round two!
And on to the after-party!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this, Trainer.
A one-on-one showdown to celebrate Christmas.
And so, their night seemed to stretch on forever.
And the Christmas night grew deeper.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, seeing as it's Christmas,
why don't we treat the fans to some extra-special service?
choice_data_list: Extraordinary fan service... like what?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, what we're going to do is—
a "Race with the Fans."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Of course, we're not actually going to run. I figured there'd be someone who'd want to challenge me—the undisputed greatest board game player in the world.

I figured as much.
In other words—
choice_data_list: An online match?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That is how it is. Let us announce it now
and hold it quietly without making a scene.
And when we made the announcement—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: "Please, have a match with me!!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: "I look forward to working with you too!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look at all these people... Pretty crazy, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
an insane amount has gathered, but...
choice_data_list: This is... it might be impossible for everyone after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That being said, they went out of their way to gather here.
Some kind of plan... A good plan would be...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Right, how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Testing, testing. Can you hear me?
From now on, your opponent will be—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Me and the Trainer.
We'll split into two groups.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You're every bit the strategist I am now, Trainer. We're already—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Together, we are one.
Rulership smirks out of the corner of her eye.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, bring it on.
Can anyone really hand a defeat
to the strongest duo around?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Game start, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah...!

text_block_list.text:
Passionate exchanges and matchups continued.
Rulership and I thoroughly enjoyed a Christmas that felt like it would never end.
